steps.content: Getting through the incited crowd was hard enough. To make matters worse, Ignis finds she's lost track of her Chief.
Relieved to feel the shackles are still active, she figures Chief is okay, easing her worried mind.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Oh? Aren't you the young lady with the red hair?

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: How come you're here? I thought you already found your delicate-looking friend?
Ignis jumps at the sound, turning to see the "culprit" she's briefly crossed paths with in Fortuna.
She had said she hadn't closed her eyes for three days just to take care of her little brother, but right now, the exhaustion that once marked her features has disappeared.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Ah, right... but I kinda... lost track of Chie... I mean, ${PlayerName}... I figured, maybe if I wait here, he might come back to find me...
steps.female_content: Ah, right... but I kinda... lost track of Chie... I mean, ${PlayerName}... I figured, maybe if I wait here, she might come back to find me...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Oh, I see. Why don't you come and take a break over here? I can make you some tea. You seem pretty worn out.
Without thinking, Ignis takes a step back and scans her surroundings.
That's when she notices she's unknowingly made her way back to the street she had escaped to after the jailbreak.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Come over, relax. My window has a view of this spot, so if your friend shows up, you'll see him.
steps.female_content: Come over, relax. My window has a view of this spot, so if your friend shows up, you'll see her.

steps.content: Perhaps it's her comforting smile, Ignis can't help but nod in agreement.
It's a charming little room. The clean, neat table is draped with a white tablecloth, and there's a vase with a red flower on it.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: It's the same color as your hair! It looks beautiful!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Th-Thanks...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Would you like something to drink? But I'm afraid all I have to offer right now is some water.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: However, for dinner, how about we make an apple pie together? The chef next door gave me three lovely apples~

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Cook? Me? Oh no, no way, I'm a disaster in the kitchen, really, don't make me cook!
Ignis reacts as if she's heard the wildest story, suddenly standing up and pacing towards the window in disbelief.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: A-and, are you really planning to use the stove and cook a meal here so grandly?!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Weren't you, like, just fleeing from your prison cell?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Your story's still all over the news, you know! Maybe it's best to head back and fill in the prison guard lady...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Why should I do that?
The girl, brow furrowed, places her basket beside the chopping board, in a kitchen brimming with cooking utensils, just like the one Ignis has always imagined.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: jojo

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: We just need to live our lives and not worry about it.
Ignis looks down, her face hidden from view.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: But... this might spell trouble, you know.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: No, it's fine, I have faith in them.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: We can't just count on luck! Don't get lost in wishful thinking!!
Ignis looks up, tears welling in her eyes, her lips quivering as she struggles to keep her composure.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You just don't get it... the abilities you have, the things that have happened... you just can't wipe them away or hide them...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The moment you let your guard down, that's when... they'll steal your happiness all over again.
